notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Forerunner of the Empire indestructible.
{6}{G}{G}available.
description:
Give Forerunner of the Empire indestructible by any method.
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Polyraptor enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Empire, causing it to deal 1 damage to each creature.
All Polyraptor creatures trigger.
Resolve one Polyraptor trigger, creating one token copy of Polyraptor.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to deal damage with Forerunner of the Empire triggers and resolving an arbitrarily high number of Polyraptor triggers.
